purpose: Curated entry points for discovering NEW small organizers and events, not enabled event importers. These are research-only pages. A returned link is not confirmation of an event, location, schedule, or image rights.
rules: Prefer original independent organizers, artist/vendor touring pages and community-run marketplaces, with a few explicitly secondary local indexes for discovering unknown organizers.
Never infer an event year from the date a webpage was posted, or assume a seasonal market recurrence. Vendor listings are leads, not independently verified event calendars.
Inspect actual geographic venue/location for every proposed event; out-of-region oddities and goth markets are common search false positives.
Don't automatically fetch found outbound links or private/blocked social profiles, mirror flyers, or auto-publish event data.
Focus on punk, hardcore, metal, goth, weird/occult/oddities markets, queer/DIY makers, zines, record fairs, vintage pop-ups and independent arts; do not crawl all routine holiday bazaars.
